title: Immunofluorescence and Confocal Imaging in Brain Sections and Image Analysis
author: Chuyu Chen
materials: incubate with primary antibodies in 5% goat serum with 0.2% Triton X-100, 48-72 hrs at at 4°C
incubated with secondary antibodies—Alexa Fluor‱ 488, Alexa Fluor‱ 568, and Alexa Fluor‱ 647 (1:300, invitrogen) in 5% goat serum with 0.2% Triton X-100, 3hrs, RT
Lrrk2 signal in SNc sections: anti-Th (1:1000, SYSY), anti-Aldh1a1 (1:300, Abcam), anti-LRRK2/Dardarin clone N241A/34 (1:200, NeuroMab), anti-GFP (1:1000, invitrogen).
Striatal Th expressing fibers : : anti-Th (1:1000, SYSY), anti-Aldh1a1 (1:300, Abcam), and anti-Vmat2 (1:200, Immunostar).
Area and intensity are measured automatically by software.

steps.title: Perfuse mice and fix tissue
steps.instruction: Perfuse mice at 5 ml/min with 50 ml PBS followed by 50 ml 4 % paraformaldehyde in PBS.

steps.title: Post‑fix brains overnight
steps.instruction: Post‑fix harvested brains in 4 % paraformaldehyde in PBS overnight at 4 °C.

steps.title: Cryoprotect in 30% sucrose
steps.instruction: Incubate fixed brains in PBS containing 30 % sucrose for 48 hours at 4 °C.

steps.title: Cryosection at 30 µm and store
steps.instruction: Cryosection brains at 30 µm thickness; collect slices in PBS with 0.1 % sodium azide and store at 4 °C for immunohistochemistry.

steps.title: Block sections with serum/Triton
steps.instruction: Incubate brain sections in 5 % goat serum containing 0.2 % Triton X‑100 for 2 hours at room temperature.

steps.title: Antigen retrieval at 100 °C
steps.instruction: Incubate sections in antigen unmasking solution (Vector H‑3300, 48 µl diluted in 5 ml water) at 100 °C for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Cool sections to room temperature
steps.instruction: Allow sections to cool to room temperature for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Wash sections with PBS
steps.instruction: Wash sections three times with PBS, 5 minutes each wash at room temperature.

steps.title: Overnight incubation at 4 °C
steps.instruction: Incubate sections overnight at 4 °C in 5 % goat serum with 0.2 % Triton X‑100.

steps.title: Final PBS washes
steps.instruction: Wash sections three times with PBS, 5 minutes each wash at room temperature.

steps.title: Mount sections with ProLong Diamond
steps.instruction: Mount sections using ProLong™ Diamond Antifade Mountant (Invitrogen).

steps.title: Acquire confocal images (60×)
steps.instruction: Image sections on a Nikon CSU‑W1 SoRa confocal using a 60× objective, acquiring Z‑stacks at 0.1 mm intervals at 1,024 × 1,024 pixel resolution for TH fiber volume measurements.

steps.title: Acquire confocal images (20×)
steps.instruction: Image sections on the same system with a 20× objective to assess LRRK2 expression, TH area, intensity, and APEX2 expression.

steps.title: Acquire confocal images (A1R)
steps.instruction: Acquire additional images on a Nikon A1R microscope at 1,024 × 1,024 pixel resolution, keeping laser power constant across genotypes for each channel.

steps.title: Background subtraction with rolling ball
steps.instruction: Perform rolling‑ball background subtraction on all images using Nikon Elements software.

steps.title: Segment TH and Aldh1a1 surfaces
steps.instruction: Use the surface‑rendering function to segment TH‑positive cells and Aldh1a1‑positive cells.

steps.title: Quantify Aldh1a1 intensity in TH
steps.instruction: Measure mean Aldh1a1 intensity within the TH surface; consider a cell positive if its intensity exceeds 1.5 × the average TH channel mean intensity.

steps.title: Measure LRRK2 intensity in TH‑positive cells
steps.instruction: Automatically measure LRRK2 intensity within TH‑positive cells using the analysis software.

steps.title: Measure TH fiber volume
steps.instruction: Segment TH fibers with the surface‑rendering function, filter segments where “Number of voxels Img=1” > 50, and let the software automatically calculate TH fiber volume.

steps.title: High‑magnification analysis of TH axons
steps.instruction: Segment TH, Aldh1a1, and Vmat2 proteins using surface rendering; filter segments with “Number of voxels Img=1” > 50; apply an overlapped‑area ratio (TH‑Aldh1a1) > 0.4 to identify Aldh1a1‑positive TH axons; similarly filter Vmat2 within TH terminals using an overlapped‑area ratio (TH‑Vmat2) > 0.4.

steps.title: Low‑magnification analysis of TH
steps.instruction: Segment TH using surface rendering, filter segments with “Number of voxels Img=1” > 50, and let the software automatically measure TH area and intensity.
